mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers corporate profit concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO decline), manufacturing sector weakness leads to reduced corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a strong labor market combined with accommodative monetary policy, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises and FEDFUNDS declines, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: During strong consumer demand regimes (HOUST and RSAFS both rising), corporate revenue growth accelerates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
